messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm about to push a tiny TF change to Service -> targetPort/targetType for the inference NLB. Trying to switch health checks to targetType: IP to avoid nodeport mapping issues. quick QA: will that impact the ALB or gateway secret binding?

marta: Generally OK but depends on how the gateway is wired. If you're changing to `targetType: IP` we need to ensure readiness/liveness endpoints still hit pod IPs and the NLB healthcheck uses pod IPs too. Which service is this exactly?

sam: `svc/inference-http` in `prod` (kube svc currently clusterIP -> nodeport + nlb). TF diff is here: `modules/infra/k8s/service.tf` — switching `spec.type` remains `LoadBalancer` but add `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-target-type: "ip"` annotation.

ben: FWIW we had a similar incident where probe targetPort was set to the nodePort var and healthchecks started failing with targetType=ip. Make sure `port` + `targetPort` line up with the container port.

sam: Good call. Current manifest (simplified):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-http
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-target-type: "ip"
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
  - port: 443
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app: inference
```

ivy: What about `externalTrafficPolicy`? If you want source IP preservation we usually set `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` — but that affects healthchecks and node selection. With targetType=ip you *shouldn't* need nodePort mapping, but check gateways.

sam: Right now externalTrafficPolicy is not set (defaults to Cluster). I'm leaning to keep Cluster for even distribution. Any secret binding/ALB implication?

marta: For the Gateway API / ALB type routing we had a secret-binding flow that expects the service to expose TLS at port 443 and the secret referenced in the Gateway TLS config. That is independent of targetType, mostly. The problem is when healthchecks hit nodePort and pods are on different nodes — then NLB healthcheck fails and the gateway marks endpoint unhealthy. With targetType=ip healthchecks hit pod IPs directly which is better.

ben: Also double-check if we have an Ingress/Gateway behind that expects `targetPort: 8443` or something legacy — small mismatch can silently break.

sam: I'll run `kubectl get svc inference-http -o yaml` after apply in staging. Planning to open PR in 5m.

ivy: Ping me in the PR. Also add a quick note in TF change that this is to fix healthcheck flapping, link the postmortem from last time (infra-2025-09-nlb-flap).

sam: Will do. One more question: secret rotation — do we need to rebind the secret when switching target type?

marta: No, secret binding is at the Gateway/ALB TLS level, not the Service targetType. Only time you'd need to rebind is if you change hostname or Gateway resource.

ben: If you want maximum safety, do a staged rollout: apply to staging -> verify `kubectl describe svc` and `kubectl get endpoints` show pod IPs, then apply to prod in maintenance window.

sam: Ok staged plan. I'll also run `curl` to health endpoint from each node to validate.

ben: Optional TF note: annotate terraform resource with `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [metadata[0].annotations] }`? Not recommended generally, but useful if controller rewrites annotations.

ivy: Also add an e2e check in the Jenkins job that validates healthcheck status on the NLB for the svc after deploy. Could be a small script that polls `aws elbv2 describe-target-health` for the target group.

sam: Good idea. I'll add smoke checks in the PR pipeline.

deploy-bot: CI | terraform-plan passed for branch `sam/tgt-ip-change` (plan id: 87fd2). :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all — PR up: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4567 — marked reviewer: @marta @ivy. Will not merge until staging smoke checks green. :eyes:

marta: Reviewing now. If all smoke checks pass, shipit during the 0200->0300 UTC window. :shipit:

ben: Cheers. If anything odd, revert annotation and we can fall back to nodePort mapping.

sam: Will update thread with results.
